Major Remodels in Kechi, KS

Major remodels in Kechi span a wider quality range than in most similarly sized communities. The older farmhouse-era homes near the original townsite need genuine infrastructure-level renovation — not just cosmetic updates. The newer custom builds that have become more common in north Sedgwick County represent a different challenge: a homeowner who chose Kechi for quality and space and now needs a comprehensive renovation that meets the standards of the home they're in.

Both deserve work done right, and both need a contractor who can execute at the appropriate quality level. Wheatland Construction handles both.

We're a Veterans Approved Builder (ID: 00899), Home Advisor Certified since 2019, and family-owned since 2018. We serve Kechi and north Sedgwick County.

Major Remodels in Kechi by Home Type

Older Kechi homes (pre-1980): Comprehensive renovation — kitchen and bath gut and rebuild, electrical service update, plumbing infrastructure assessment, flooring throughout, interior finish. These homes can have galvanized supply lines and older drain infrastructure that a major remodel is the right time to address.

Newer Kechi custom builds: Renovation at quality level. Semi-custom or custom kitchen rebuild, premium bathroom renovations, additions that match the home's original quality, and finishes that are appropriate for a custom-built north Sedgwick County home. Not contractor-grade work in a custom-grade home.

Kechi Major Remodel Scope Examples

Whole-home kitchen/bath/flooring: Full gut and rebuild on kitchen and all bathrooms, consistent LVP or hardwood flooring throughout, updated lighting, new interior doors and trim. 4–7 months.

Structural open-concept conversion + kitchen: Load-bearing wall removal, kitchen expansion, new cabinetry, countertops, appliances. Requires structural engineering. 3–5 months.

Custom build comprehensive update: High-spec kitchen and bath renovation on a 15–20-year-old custom build. Semi-custom cabinetry, premium tile, quality fixtures. 4–6 months.

Permits in Kechi

Sedgwick County Planning and Building for unincorporated properties. City of Kechi for homes inside city limits. We handle all permits.

How We Approach Major Remodeling in Kechi

Major remodels involve more coordination than single-room projects - structural assessments, permit packages with engineered drawings where required, phased scheduling to keep portions of the home livable, and subcontractor coordination for specialized trades. We manage all of it.

We price in writing with full scope documentation before work starts. Change orders are documented and approved before work proceeds.

Wheatland Construction has held Veterans Approved Builder status (ID: 00899) since we opened and has been Home Advisor Certified since 2019. We're licensed and insured in Kansas.

In Kechi, the mix of older farmhouse homes and newer custom builds means we adjust scope and material specification to match the home's original quality level.

Frequently Asked Questions About Major Remodels in Kechi

How much does a major remodel cost in Kechi, KS?

Kechi major remodels range from $80,000 for an older home multi-room renovation to $350,000+ for a comprehensive high-spec renovation of a custom build. We scope to the home and the project. Written, line-item estimates.

What quality level do you work at for Kechi custom home renovations?

We match the home. Kechi custom builds have real finish standards and a major remodel needs to respect that. Semi-custom or custom cabinetry, premium tile, quality fixtures — we discuss at the consultation.

Who handles permits for major remodeling in Kechi?

Sedgwick County Planning and Building for unincorporated properties. City of Kechi for homes inside city limits. We handle all permits.

How long does a Kechi major remodel take?

3–8 months depending on scope. High-spec custom home renovations with semi-custom material lead times take toward the longer end.

Do you handle structural changes (wall removal, open concepts) in Kechi homes?

Yes — with engineering. Load-bearing wall removal requires structural engineering sign-off; we coordinate with structural engineers as part of the project scope.

Does a major remodel add value in Kechi?

Yes. North Sedgwick County custom home buyers pay for quality and space. A well-executed major remodel — especially in a custom build — returns proportionally in appraised value and market appeal.
